            if current == '/':
                # Already at root
                i += 1
                continue

            last_slash = current.rfind('/')

                current = '/'
            else:
                current = current[:last_slash]
            i += 1
            continue

        if current == '/':

        if candidate in links:

                return None

                else:

            target_components = target.split('/')

            if target.startswith('/'):
                current = ''
            continue
        
        # Not a symlink, just use it
        current = candidate
        i += 1
    
    # Final result
